parameters.name: DisplayName
parameters.description: The full name of the user.

parameters.name: Email
parameters.description: The email address of the user.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Cloud Call Center.

parameters.name: Phone
parameters.description: The phone number of the user.

parameters.name: PrivateOutboundNumberId
parameters.description: The PhoneNumberId of the personal outbound number.

parameters.name: RoleId
parameters.description: The role ID to assign to the user.

parameters.name: SkillGroupId
parameters.description:
The skill group ID to associate with the user.

SkillGroupId.1 indicates that the user is associated with only one skill group. To associate the user with multiple skill groups, specify multiple values, such as SkillGroupId.1, SkillGroupId.2, and SkillGroupId.3.

parameters.name: SkillLevel
parameters.description:
The skill level corresponding to the skill group that the user is added to.

**SkillLevel.1** indicates the skill level for SkillGroupId.1. If multiple SkillGroupId values are specified, the same number of SkillLevel values must be specified.

parameters.name: UserId
parameters.description:
The ID of the user to modify.

Note that this is the unique identifier of the RAM user in the Cloud Call Center instance, not the RamId. It is a UUID.
